title: External Accuracy Runtime Adapter Testbank Adoption
canonical_admission: F-CI46 plus F-CI46P preserved by F-CI47
goal: Permanently register and continuously replay the canonically admitted typed external-accuracy packet-to-runtime-contract adapter boundary without moving external source verification, policy selection, file parsing, numerical accuracy selection or production coupling admission into SWAP5.
allowed_changes: add one bounded F-TB08 adapter-case registry
add F-TB08 validator, replay runner and workflow
add F-TB08 documentation, run log, qualification status and invariant audit
forbidden_changes: F-TB01 through F-TB07 manifests, case IDs or semantics
external source byte verification inside SWAP5
file or JSON parsing in the kernel/runtime adapter
required_coverage: application and temporal source-verification attestation fail-closed behavior
application-versus-temporal provenance separation and reuse rejection
canonical application-requirement and temporal-allocation validation with default-unconfigured output on rejection
explicit source-verification, parsing, policy-selection, production-coupling and mass-conservation nonclaims

profiles.FAST: registry, immutable-parent support, canonical source/reference, adapter provenance and static boundary checks
profiles.CANONICAL: compile and execute immutable F-GC14 adapter tests against current canonical source at O0
profiles.RELEASE: CANONICAL plus repeated O0 and O2 transcript identity plus support-only delta check
profiles.DEEP: same qualified evidence set; no silent broadening into project-specific accuracy or production coupling

hard_nonclaims: no real project H_app is qualified
no real project A_temporal is qualified
no real project direct temporal head-error budget is qualified
no external source bytes or digests are verified by the adapter
no file or JSON format is parsed by the adapter
no project policy is selected or derived
no production SWAP-MODFLOW coupling is admitted
no physical coupling equation or solver is changed
mass conservation remains hard and unrelaxed
